parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: $json.classify_prompt }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.1, responseMimeType: 'application/json', responseSchema: { type: 'OBJECT', properties: { type: { type: 'STRING', enum: ['database','disk_storage','memory','network','certificate','deployment','auth','cpu','unknown'] }, severity: { type: 'STRING', enum: ['low','medium','high','critical'] }, confidence: { type: 'NUMBER' }, evidence: { type: 'ARRAY', items: { type: 'STRING' } } }, required: ['type','severity','confidence','evidence'] } } }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'models/' + $('Config').first().json.EMBED_MODEL, content: { parts: [{ text: $('Parse Classification').first().json.text }] }, outputDimensionality: 768 }) }}

parameters.query:
(SELECT 'runbook' AS kind, r.title, c.content AS text,
        round((1 - (c.embedding <=> $1::vector))::numeric, 3) AS score
 FROM runbook_chunks c JOIN runbooks r ON r.id = c.runbook_id
 ORDER BY c.embedding <=> $1::vector LIMIT 4)
UNION ALL
(SELECT 'past' AS kind, p.title, p.summary || ' Resolution: ' || p.resolution AS text,
        round((1 - (p.embedding <=> $1::vector))::numeric, 3) AS score
 FROM past_incidents p ORDER BY p.embedding <=> $1::vector LIMIT 3)
UNION ALL
(SELECT 'actions' AS kind, r.title, c.content AS text, NULL::numeric AS score
 FROM runbook_chunks c JOIN runbooks r ON r.id = c.runbook_id
 WHERE c.runbook_id = (SELECT runbook_id FROM runbook_chunks ORDER BY embedding <=> $1::vector LIMIT 1)
   AND c.content LIKE '## Recommended Actions%');

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: $json.plan_prompt }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.1, responseMimeType: 'application/json', responseSchema: { type: 'ARRAY', items: { type: 'OBJECT', properties: { step: { type: 'STRING' }, detail: { type: 'STRING' }, source: { type: 'STRING' } }, required: ['step','detail','source'] } } } }) }}
